October 21, 2026 October 21, 2026 ServerlessDays Cardiff 2026 UTC Following the success of ServerlessDays Cardiff 2025 with over 300 registrations, we want to make this years edition bigger and better than ever. We are looking for speakers with a story to share, whether you consider yourself an expert, or someone taking their first steps. We want to appeal to a broad range of experience. We also want to cover real life case studies, understanding what went well and what did not. We are interested in the use of tech for good. We are also keen to focus on talks that cover the use of generative and agentic AI, machine learning, cloud security, sovereign cloud and even containers.
